input-field.name: apiPublicKey
input-field.label: Public Key
input-field.helpText: Your Flutterwave public API key. This can be found in your Flutterwave dashboard under API keys.

input-field.name: apiSecretKey
input-field.label: Secret Key
input-field.helpText: Your Flutterwave secret API key. Keep this secure and never share it publicly.

input-field.name: secretHash
input-field.label: Webhook Secret Hash
input-field.helpText: The secret hash you set under Settings > Webhooks in your Flutterwave dashboard. It is a value you choose yourself, not one of your API keys, and it must match the dashboard exactly. Webhooks are rejected until this is set.

input-field.name: enableSandbox
input-field.label: Enable Sandbox
input-field.helpText: Enable this option to use Flutterwave's sandbox environment for testing payments.

input-field.name: apiPublicKeySandbox
input-field.label: Public Key
input-field.helpText: Your Flutterwave public API key. This can be found in your Flutterwave dashboard under API keys.

input-field.name: apiSecretKeySandbox
input-field.label: Secret Key
input-field.helpText: Your Flutterwave secret API key. Keep this secure and never share it publicly.

input-field.name: secretHashSandbox
input-field.label: Webhook Secret Hash
input-field.helpText: The secret hash for your Flutterwave test environment. Flutterwave lets you set a different hash for test and live, so this is kept separate from the live one.

input-field.name: title
input-field.label: Title
input-field.helpText: The payment method title that customers will see during checkout.

input-field.name: description
input-field.label: Description
input-field.helpText: A brief description of the payment method that will be shown to customers.

component.name: sw-media-field
logo
component.label: Payment Method Logo
component.helpText: Upload a custom logo that will be displayed next to the payment method name during checkout.

input-field.name: paymentOptions
input-field.label: Payment Options
input-field.helpText: Select which payment options to enable. Leave empty to show all available options to customers.

input-field.name: sessionDuration
input-field.label: Session Duration (minutes)
input-field.helpText: The duration in minutes that a payment session remains valid before expiring.

input-field.name: maxRetryAttempt
input-field.label: Max Retry Attempts
input-field.helpText: The maximum number of times a customer can retry a failed payment before being blocked.

input-field.name: refundEnabled
input-field.label: Enable Refunds
Erstattungen aktivieren
Activer les remboursements
input-field.helpText: Allow administrators to issue Flutterwave refunds from the order detail page.
Erlaubt Administratoren, Flutterwave-Erstattungen auf der Bestelldetailseite auszulösen.
Permet aux administrateurs d'émettre des remboursements Flutterwave depuis la page de détail de la commande.

input-field.name: minimumRefundAmount
input-field.label: Minimum Refund Amount
Mindesterstattungsbetrag
Montant minimum de remboursement
input-field.helpText: The smallest refund allowed, in the order currency's major units (e.g. 100 for ₦100). Leave empty to use Flutterwave's per-currency minimum.
Der kleinste zulässige Erstattungsbetrag in der Hauptwährungseinheit der Bestellung (z. B. 100 für ₦100). Leer lassen, um das währungsspezifische Minimum von Flutterwave zu verwenden.
Le plus petit remboursement autorisé, dans l'unité principale de la devise de la commande (par ex. 100 pour ₦100). Laissez vide pour utiliser le minimum par devise de Flutterwave.

input-field.name: collectBankData
input-field.label: Enable Bank Data Collection
Bankdatenerfassung aktivieren
Activer la collecte des données bancaires
input-field.helpText: Show a bank-account form in the customer account area. Account numbers are verified against Flutterwave before they are saved.
Zeigt im Kundenkonto ein Formular für Bankverbindungen an. Kontonummern werden vor dem Speichern über Flutterwave geprüft.
Affiche un formulaire de compte bancaire dans l'espace client. Les numéros de compte sont vérifiés auprès de Flutterwave avant d'être enregistrés.

input-field.name: bankCountry
input-field.label: Bank Country (ISO code)
Bankland (ISO-Code)
Pays de la banque (code ISO)
input-field.helpText: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose bank list is offered (e.g. NG, GH, KE, UG, ZA, TZ).
ISO-3166-1-alpha-2-Land, dessen Bankliste angeboten wird (z. B. NG, GH, KE, UG, ZA, TZ).
Pays ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 dont la liste des banques est proposée (par ex. NG, GH, KE, UG, ZA, TZ).

input-field.name: showBvnField
input-field.label: Show BVN Field
BVN-Feld anzeigen
Afficher le champ BVN
input-field.helpText: Show the BVN (Bank Verification Number) field. Requires Flutterwave BVN approval before resolved verification can be enabled; without it, the BVN is validated for format and stored only.

Zeigt das BVN-Feld (Bank Verification Number) an. Erfordert eine Flutterwave-BVN-Freigabe, bevor die aufgelöste Verifizierung aktiviert werden kann; ohne diese wird die BVN nur auf Format geprüft und gespeichert.
Affiche le champ BVN (numéro de vérification bancaire). Nécessite l'approbation BVN de Flutterwave avant d'activer la vérification résolue ; sans elle, le BVN est seulement validé et stocké.

input-field.name: requireBvn
input-field.label: Require BVN
BVN erforderlich
BVN obligatoire
input-field.helpText: If enabled, the BVN field is mandatory when the bank form is submitted.
Wenn aktiviert, ist das BVN-Feld beim Absenden des Bankformulars obligatorisch.
Si activé, le champ BVN est obligatoire lors de l'envoi du formulaire bancaire.

input-field.name: enableDebugging
input-field.label: Enable Detailed Logging
Detaillierte Protokollierung aktivieren
Activer la journalisation détaillée
input-field.helpText: Logs detailed information about payment events to help diagnose issues. Should be disabled in production to avoid exposing sensitive data. Errors are always recorded, whether this is enabled or not.

Protokolliert detaillierte Informationen zu Zahlungsereignissen zur Fehlerdiagnose. Im Produktivbetrieb deaktivieren, um sensible Daten zu schützen. Fehler werden unabhängig von dieser Einstellung immer protokolliert.

Enregistre des informations détaillées sur les événements de paiement pour faciliter le diagnostic. À désactiver en production afin de ne pas exposer de données sensibles. Les erreurs sont toujours enregistrées, que cette option soit activée ou non.

input-field.name: logLevels
input-field.label: Log levels to log
Zu protokollierende Log-Level
Niveaux de journalisation à enregistrer
input-field.helpText: Select which log levels should be recorded when detailed logging is enabled. Leave empty to record all of them. Error and above are always recorded regardless of this selection.

Wählen Sie aus, welche Log-Level aufgezeichnet werden sollen, wenn die detaillierte Protokollierung aktiviert ist. Leer lassen, um alle aufzuzeichnen. Fehler und höher werden unabhängig von dieser Auswahl immer aufgezeichnet.

Sélectionnez les niveaux à enregistrer lorsque la journalisation détaillée est activée. Laissez vide pour tous les enregistrer. Les erreurs et niveaux supérieurs sont toujours enregistrés, quelle que soit cette sélection.
